“I like Dubai, but my budget is not enough to buy property and get residency”?

Because now this conversation is worth opening again.

observation.text: The text employs rhetorical questions to engage the reader and introduce the idea that circumstances may have changed regarding Dubai's visa policies.

citations.quote: This is what many countries will never be able outcompete Us.

observation.text: The author contrasts Dubai's initiatives with those of unnamed other countries to emphasize Dubai's competitive advantage in attracting talent and investment.

citations.quote: With the new update to the 2-year property owner visa, Dubai once again showed what I love about this country.

summary.text: Dubai has updated the 2-year property owner visa to make it easier for more people to connect their future with the UAE.

citations.quote: Dubai 2040 master plan. It is about attracting more people, keeping them here and giving them enough reasons to build their future here.

summary.text: Dubai has a plan to attract more people, keep them here, and provide reasons for them to build their future in the country.
